name: MCP Inspector
what: The official developer tool for testing MCP servers. It connects to a local or remote server and lets you list and call its tools, resources and prompts from a web UI, a scriptable CLI or a terminal UI. Version 2 needs Node 22.19 or newer.
who: Anyone building or debugging an MCP server who wants to see exactly what it exposes before wiring it into an agent.

setup.text: Open the web UI against a local stdio server:
Or use the CLI in scripts and CI:
It stores OAuth tokens and env secrets in your OS keychain when one is available; see the README if you're on a machine without one.

prompts: Help me write an Inspector CLI command that calls my search tool with query=test and checks the output.
My server's tools don't show up in the Inspector. Look at my server code and find out why.
Add a CI step that runs the Inspector CLI tools/list against my server.
